data.title: NEAR Protocol Is Up 122% in a Month While Bitcoin Gained 8%. Can the Rally Last?
data.description: NEAR Protocol has rocketed past Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana over the past month, but the surge lacks any confirmed catalyst, and a massive overhang of underwater sellers from 2022 looms over the rally.
